{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_lp_hist", "thread_id": "th_lp_hist", "from_": "me", "to": ["web-team@company.example.com"], "subject": "Re: Dec Landing Page Analysis", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2025-12-20T10:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_lp_hist
来源：me
收件人：web-team@company.example.com
日期：2025-12-20T10:00:00Z
主题：Re: Dec Landing Page Analysis
Here's the December analysis. Framework I used:
- Pages with CVR < 3% AND > 2000 visits = needs optimization (high traffic, low conversion)
- Include ALL qualifying pages: both underperformers and top performers for comparison
- Check notes column for data quality issues and exclusions
- Calculate actual CVR from conversions/visits when CVR field looks suspicious
- Include aggregate visits and conversions across all non-excluded pages
- Render aggregate integer totals with comma separators
- Flag 0% CVR pages as critical priority
- Send to web-team@company.example.com only"}
